mapper.select: SELECT vs.id, vs.share_code AS shareCode, vs.task_id AS taskId, vs.expire_time AS expireTime, vs.view_count AS viewCount, vs.create_time AS createTime, it.model_name AS modelName, it.total_detections AS totalDetections, CASE WHEN vs.expire_time > NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isActive FROM video_shares vs INNER JOIN inference_tasks it ON vs.task_id = it.id WHERE vs.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY vs.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT vs.id, vs.share_code AS shareCode, vs.task_id AS taskId, vs.user_id AS userId, vs.expire_time AS expireTime, vs.view_count AS viewCount, vs.create_time AS createTime, it.model_name AS modelName, it.total_detections AS totalDetections, u.user_name AS username, CASE WHEN vs.expire_time > NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isActive FROM video_shares vs INNER JOIN inference_tasks it ON vs.task_id = it.id LEFT JOIN users u ON vs.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY vs.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
